{{Quote|Are any mission officers still in service?''"<br />"''Two are on active duty at Yutusk&hellip; Commander Bly and Lt. Galle.|Darth Vader and Erv Lekauf|<ref name="evasive">''[[Evasive Action: End Game]]''</ref>}}
'''Yutusk''' was a temperate backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Yutusk system/Legends|Yutusk system]] subjugated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was the homeworld of [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Vimran Trell]], whom was conscripted in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. His parents [[Tranira Trell]] and [[Francill Trell]] were killed when Imperial forces rounded up and executed suspected [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizers on Yutusk.

It had been a major planet in [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] [[Xim's empire|empire]], having served as the Sixth Throne.<ref name="Xim Week" />
